Commentary.Commentary: That's it then from this game and it is West Indies who have stunned New Zealand and have taken a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. The next game becomes even more crucial for the visitors as it is a must-win for them. It will be played on Friday, 19th August and the match will begin at 11.30 pm IST (6 pm GMT). The build-up for that game will begin much sooner and do join us then. Cheers!

Nicholas Pooran, the captain of West Indies is in for a chat now. Pooran says that he looked at the surface and decided to go with three spinners as it looked dry and they wanted to give the opportunity to the young guys. He praises both the debutants (Yannic Cariah and Kevin Sinclair) for their bowling performances. He adds that they knew that the chase was going to be tough but it was all about one partnership and he got that with Shamarh Brooks. He says that they have been working hard for the last three series and finally it paid off.

Kiwi skipper, Kane Williamson joins in for a chat. When asked about their batting performance, he says that it was a big effort from his players as the conditions were very challenging. He gives credit to West Indies bowlers for the way they bowled and says they made the most of the conditions. Claims that they could learn from their performance. Mentions that at the halfway stage, they were still in the game but credit to the West Indies batters for adjusting to the conditions. He adds that he feels the effort was there from his side and it is a good learning curve for them. Mentions that he is hopeful that they can put things together and come back strong in the next game.

Shamarh Brooks (79 off 91 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his match-winning knock. Brooks says that watching the Kiwis bat, it looked like it was tough to bat on but praises the bowlers to restrict the opposition to 190. He adds that while chasing it was important to build partnerships in the middle. He says that he told Nicholas Pooran that they haven't got a partnership together in this format so they made sure they have one in this game and one of them sticks around till the end. He ends by saying it is a big thing to beat New Zealand and they can go from strength to strength from here.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Nicholas Pooran put New Zealand into bat and that decision didn't seem to be the right one as there was not much happening for the bowlers in the first Powerplay. Then the spinners came on and made an instant impact. New Zealand had contributions right throughout the order but none of them could convert those starts. The Windies spinners and Alzarri Joseph picked up wickets at regular intervals and made sure that the opposition got no momentum in their innings. With just 191 runs needed for the win, a big knock from Shamarh Brooks was enough to blow the opposition out of the contest and hand West Indies a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Stick around for the presentation.

New Zealand were let down by their batters to be honest but their bowling too wasn't particularly impressive. Trent Boult did give the perfect start under lights with an early wicket but they couldn't build on it. The surface had something in it for the spinners but due to the rain, the Kiwi spinners couldn't get the same purchase as their counterparts and were largely ineffective. In the end, the visitors did get a few of more wickets but were comprehensively defeated and will now look to bounce back in the next game.

West Indies had a small target to chase down and with a bit of rain around, the conditions got better for batting. They did lose Kyle Mayers early but Shai Hope and Shamarh Brooks steadied the ship a bit. A couple of more wickets fell but Brooks held firm from one end and scored at a brisk pace. Skipper, Nicholas Pooran gave him ample support from the other end and the pair went on to add 75 runs before Pooran had a lapse in concentration after the rain break. Brooks too fell after scoring 79 but by then, the result was put beyond doubt and Blackwood and Holder saw their side home.

It has been a long time coming but West Indies have finally got an ODI victory and they have accomplished it in fine fashion. The Kiwis will be thoroughly disappointed with that performance and they have been handed their first ODI loss in 2022.

FOUR! Jason Holder finishes off in style. Mitchell Santner tosses this one up, full and around off, Jason Holder makes room and crunches it through covers for a boundary. West Indies win by 5 wickets and take a 1-0 lead in this series.
Five dots on the trot. This is again full and on middle, Jason Holder leans on and defends it onto the pitch.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Jason Holder blocks it out.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Jason Holder pushes it towards the bowler who makes a good stop.
Quicker one, full and on middle, Jason Holder tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Floated, short and on off, Jason Holder makes room and guides it towards point.

Trent Boult bangs this one in short and outside off, Jason Holder goes for the pull but does not time his shot well. The ball goes towards the deep square leg fence and they take a single as the fielder comes and cuts it off. Still 2 runs needed!
Five dot balls so far! Jason Holder unable to get the winning runs. Trent Boult bowls this on a good length and wide outside off, Jason Holder slashes this straight to point.
Trent Boult goes full and wide outside off, Jason Holder strokes this straight to mid off.
Trent Boult bowls this on a good length and outside off, Jason Holder pushes the ball towards point.
Bowls this on a good length and just outside off. Jason Holder looks to defend this but there is some extra bounce and the ball hits his glove and falls into the pitch.
Trent Boult begins with a short delivery well outside off, Jason Holder sways away from it nonetheless.

FOUR! That has been swatted away! Tim Southee pulls his length back and bowls this outside off, Jermaine Blackwood has room to swing his arms and cuts this past point for a boundary to deep point. West Indies are now just one hit away from a win!
Touch fuller this time and pitching on middle and leg, Jason Holder clips this towards square leg for another easy single.
Continues bowling on a good length without getting much purchase from the wicket. This is in line with the stumps and tucked towards deep square leg for one more single.
Gets this one to angle into the stumps from a good length. Jason Holder works this towards deep square leg and takes one.
On a good length this time and outside off, Jason Holder taps the ball towards point.
Tim Southee serves this back of a length and just outside off, Jason Holder stands tall and fends the ball down into the pitch.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Jermaine Blackwood slashes this towards the cover-point fielder.
What a jaffa! Trent Boult bowls this short and into the batter. The ball bounces sharply after pitching and zips past the swaying batter.
Fuller in length and outside the off stump, Jason Holder knocks this wide of mid off and take a quick single.
Trent Boult goes really wide outside off and short, Jermaine Blackwood cuts this to third man and takes a single.
Trent Boult goes full and outside off, Jermaine Blackwood swings wildly and gets beaten on the inside edge.
Trent Boult begins with a short delivery aimed at the batter. Jermaine Blackwood ducks under this and leaves it alone.
Pulls his length back a fraction and in line with the stumps, Jermaine Blackwood tucks this towards deep square leg and takes another run.
Tim Southee gets this one straight and full, Jason Holder clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Bowls an off-cutter this time on a fuller length and just outside off, Jason Holder feels for it and is beaten by the pace.
Tim Southee bowls a slower delivery full and outside off, Jason Holder is watchful as he taps it back down the pitch towards the bowler.
This on is angling into the pads and is bowled a fraction fuller. Jason Holder flicks this towards deep backward square leg and takes a couple of runs.
Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Jason Holder taps this back towards the bowler.
Trent Boult strays onto the pads from a good length, Jason Holder clips this towards fine leg and takes a run. He will be on strike in the next over. Just 16 runs more required.
Serves a full toss outside off, Jason Holder misses out as he hits this straight to the cover fielder.
This is short as well and way outside off, Jermaine Blackwood slashes this towards backward point and a misfield allows them to take a single.
Trent Boult bangs one in short and outside off, Jason Holder pulls this uppishly into the vacant square leg region and takes a single.
Jason Holder is in next.

OUT! TIMBER! Shamarh Brooks' outstanding innings comes to an end! He has got his team really close to the finish line. Trent Boult goes a fraction full and angles the ball into the right-hander. Shamarh Brooks plays along the wrong line and the ball beats his inside edge to shatter the stumps. New Zealand do not really celebrate as they know this is a little too late.
Trent Boult starts from 'round the wicket and serves this on a good length and outside off, Shamarh Brooks knocks this straight to cover-point.
Trent Boult (7-0-43-1) is back on.

In the air...but safe! This is full and on off, Shamarh Brooks looks to heave it away over mid-wicket but gets a thick outside edge in the air but the ball falls well short of the third man fielder. A single taken. 19 runs to win now.
Tim Southee bangs this one short and on leg, follows Blackwood well, Jermaine Blackwood gets cramped and mistimes his pull towards square leg for a single.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Jermaine Blackwood pushes it towards covers of his back foot.
A slower ball, full and on middle, Shamarh Brooks is through his lofted drive early and plays it of his toe end towards mid on and gets across for a single.
Goes fuller and on middle, Shamarh Brooks knocks it towards mid on.
Tim Southee lands this short and on leg, angling away, Jermaine Blackwood looks to pull it away but miscus it to the left of the keeper. They cross.

FOUR! A boundary to end the over. Lockie Ferguson serves this a bit short and on off again, Shimron Hetmyer slashes his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge towards the third man fence for four more runs. An expensive over by Ferguson.
On a length again and on off, Shamarh Brooks stays back and knocks it towards covers.
BEATEN! Lockie Ferguson bowls this on a good length and around off, holds its line, Shamarh Brooks looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full and on off, Shamarh Brooks blocks it out.
FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! This is on a hard length and around off, Shamarh Brooks just strokes it past the keeper and towards the third man fence for a boundary.

TWO BYES! Lockie Ferguson bangs this short and on middle, gets extra bounce of the surface, Shamarh Brooks ducks under it and Tom Latham can only get some finger tips on it. It goes behind the keeper and the batters run two.
Good-length delivery bowled quick and outside off, Jermaine Blackwood defends this back to the bowler who feigns a throw at the stumps.
Tim Southee goes short and outside off, Shamarh Brooks mistimes his pull and lobs the ball over the infield on the leg side. Falls into the vacant region just beyond square leg and they take one run.

Tim Southee delivers this back of a length and nipping back into the batter. Jermaine Blackwood gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball raps against his pads. They take a leg bye as the ball rolls towards cover.
This one is bowled on a good length and outside the off pole. Jermaine Blackwood knocks this towards cover-point.
Tim Southee pulls his length back this time and serves this outside off, Shamarh Brooks guides this towards third man and takes a run.
Tim Southee bowls this full and angling into the stumps, Shamarh Brooks works this towards mid on.
Well directed bouncer this time from Lockie Ferguson. Jermaine Blackwood sways out of the way and leaves it well.
Decides to bowl this on a good length and outside the off stump, Shamarh Brooks guides this to the left of point and takes a single.
WIDE! Lockie Ferguson goes short once again and Shamarh Brooks ducks once again. This time it is too high and is called wide by the umpire.
Follows the short ball with a full delivery outside off, Shamarh Brooks mistimes his short to the bowler's left.
Lockie Ferguson bangs this one in short and in line with the stumps. Shamarh Brooks ducks under this and lets it go through to the keeper.
The umpires are checking the ball right now. They are discussing and it seems like they are opting for a new ball. They have picked out a new ball and Lockie Ferguson is ready to go again.

Lockie Ferguson serves this a fraction full and angling in from outside off, Shamarh Brooks plays this with a vertical bat and taps the ball past mid on for a couple of runs. The ball seems to have slowed down due to the wet outfield.
Lockie Ferguson bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Jermaine Blackwood looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge towards deep point for single.
Goes back to bowling on a shorter length and outside off, Shamarh Brooks taps this towards point.
This on is bowled a fraction full and outside off, Shamarh Brooks defends this back to the bowler's left.
Tim Southee bowls this back of a length and angling into the batter. Jermaine Blackwood clips this towards square leg and gets off the mark straight away.
Jermaine Blackwood walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The break in play has resulted in a wicket! Tim Southee serves this on a good length and just outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to get on top of this and cut it square but the ball is too close to him. He gets an edge that goes low to Tom Latham's left and he dives forward to catch it. Nicholas Pooran makes the long walk back and West Indies have lost their fourth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Tim Southee begins with a good-length delivery just outside off, Nicholas Pooran defends this towards cover.

We are now ready to resume the game after the delay. The players are walking out to the middle. Nicholas Pooran and Shamarh Brooks are set to continue their stay at the crease for West Indies. And it will be Tim Southee to continue his incomplete over.

UPDATE 6.34 am IST (1.04 am GMT) - Good news folks! The umpires decide that the game will resume six minutes from now at 6.40 am IST (1.10 am GMT). Hopefully, this is not a false alarm as well. Fingers crossed.

UPDATE 6.06 am IST (12.36 am GMT) - Good news! The covers are being peeled off and the rain has once again eased out. This might just be another short delay. Scratch the previous update. The rain and the covers are back on and the hide and seek continues. Stick around for more updates.

UPDATE 6 am IST (12.30 am GMT) - Oh, no! The rain has just started pelting down and the players are hiding for cover. The groundstaff rushes onto the pitch with the covers as the umpires and players rush back towards the dug-out. At the moment, West Indies are more than 50 runs ahead of the DLS par score of 92. Hopefully, the rain moves away soon and play can resume. Stay tuned for further updates.
Tim Southee sticks to bowling 'round the wicket to the left-hander and bowls this full and outside the off pole. Nicholas Pooran knocks this towards cover.

Lockie Ferguson ends the over with a short ball weel directed at the batter. Nicholas Pooran looks to duck and pull at the same time. The ball gets the top edge and flies just short of fine leg. They take one more run and Nicholas Pooran will retain strike.
WIDE! Straying down leg from a good length. Nicholas Pooran watches this go through to the keeper. The umpire indicates that it is wide.
Bowls this a fraction full outside the off stump, Shamarh Brooks strokes the ball towards deep cover and they settle for a single.
Lockie Ferguson serves this on a good length and pitching outside leg, Nicholas Pooran looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge towards third man. They take a single.
This is a fraction short and wide outside off, Shamarh Brooks guides this to deep backward point for a single.
Lockie Ferguson goes full and just outside off, Nicholas Pooran taps this down to long off for a run.
Lockie Ferguson begins with a full toss outside off, Nicholas Pooran chips this down the ground towards long off. No real timing on this shot and they take a couple of runs.
Lockie Ferguson (5-0-34-0) comes back in to replace Mitchell Santner.
Slightly back of a length and outside off, Nicholas Pooran rides the bounce and works this to wide third man for another single and keeps strike.
Tim Southee goes full this time outside off, Nicholas Pooran defends this firmly towards cover.
Bowls this one just outside off and a fraction full, Shamarh Brooks clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Angles this one into the pads from a good length, Nicholas Pooran clips this towards square leg and takes a single.
This is on a good length and angling into the batter, Nicholas Pooran knocks this back to the bowler.
Tim Southee starts from 'round the wicket to the left-hander and serves this full and outside off, Nicholas Pooran swings his arms but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tim Southee (4-0-18-1) is brought back into the attack.
Floats this one full and outside off, Shamarh Brooks knocks this towards point.
This is straighter and full, Shamarh Brooks fends this towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! This has been put away well! Mitchell Santner serves this full and pitching outside leg, Shamarh Brooks sweeps this past short fine leg and picks up another boundary for himself.
Continues bowling full and in line with the stumps, Shamarh Brooks defends this down into the pitch.
Serves this one full on middle, Shamarh Brooks fends this back towards the bowler.
Mitchell Santner bowls a full delivery outside off, Nicholas Pooran shimmies down the wicket and knocks the ball to long on for a single.
Goes full again and outside off, Nicholas Pooran slashes hard at it and it goes towards third man. They take a single. After 25 overs, West Indies are 133/2.
Full and outside off, Nicholas Pooran blocks it towards point.
On a lenght and on off, Shamarh Brooks looks for the drive but gets an inside edge towards sqaure leg for a single.

UPPISH BUT SAFE! Trent Boult bangs in a bouncer and on middle, Shamarh Brooks gets surprised by at and is a bit late onto his pull shot. Luckily for him the ball lands in the vacant deep mid-wicket region. Two taken.
Full and on middle, Nicholas Pooran works it through square leg for one.
A slower ball, on a length and on leg, Shamarh Brooks misses his flick and the ball deflects of his thigh pads towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Tossed up and around middle, Nicholas Pooran tucks it towards square leg. He wants the run but his partner refuses and rightly so.
Floated, full and on middle, Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards deep square leg for another run.
A bit short and on middle, Shamarh Brooks goes on his back foot and tucks it through mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! FIFTY for Shamarh Brooks and what a way to get it as well. Mitchell Santner bowls this flatter and on off, Shamarh Brooks makes room and slices it past the short third man fielder for a boundary. This has been a really good innings by him. Can he stay till the end now?
Floated, full and on middle, Nicholas Pooran nudges it towards deep sqaure leg for one.
Tossed up, full and on off, Shamarh Brooks eases it towards long off for a single.
FOUR! SLAPPED! This is short and on off, Nicholas Pooran somehow manages to pull it past the mid on fielder for a boundary.
WIDE! Boult tries the slower ball but misses his line and bowls it down the leg. Wided.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Nicholas Pooran stays back and pushes this to point.
Full and on off, Shamarh Brooks goes for the drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads and towards square leg. They cross.
WIDE! Boult bangs in short ball but way down the leg side. Wided.
Length again and on off, Shamarh Brooks cuts it but it is brilliantly stopped by the point fielder.
This one keeps a bit low here. Trent Boult bowls this on a length and on off, Shamarh Brooks looks to cut it but misses as it does not bounce at all.
A good-length delivery and on middle, Shamarh Brooks pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated, full and on middle, Nicholas Pooran steps out of his crease and knocks it back to the bowler.
Tossed up and around off, Nicholas Pooran makes room and guides it deftly towards the third man region for a brace.

DROPPED! This flighted and on middle, turning away to the leg side, Nicholas Pooran looks to flicks it but gets a very thin inside edge towards the keeper, Tom Latham there moves to his right but cannot grab it.
Again a bit short and around off this time, Nicholas Pooran blocks it out.
Floated, short and on middle, Nicholas Pooran negotiates it well.
Tossed up, full and on off, Shamarh Brooks drives it past the cover fielder for a single.
Mitchell Santner (3-0-4-1) is back on.
A beauty to end the over! This is on a good length and around off, holds its line, Nicholas Pooran looks to block it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Trent Boult bangs a bouncer this time, on middle, Nicholas Pooran lets it go to the keeper.
Full and on middle, Nicholas Pooran stays there and blocks it onto the pitch.
Length delivery and around off, Shamarh Brooks opens the face of his bat and guides it past backwards point for one.
Goes fuller and on off, Shamarh Brooks leans on and knocks it towards covers.
Starts with a good length delivery and outside off, Nicholas Pooran cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Trent Boult (4-0-29-1) comes back into the attack now.

FOUR! Might have been intentional. This is on a length and around off, Brooks presses forward and just opens the face of the bat at the last moment to nudge the ball towards the vacant third man fence.
Staying a touch low. This is flatter again and outside off, Shamarh Brooks looks to cut off the back foot but gets beaten by the uneven bounce.
Quicker and flatter, around off, this is played straight towards the man at point.
Bowls this one flatter and on off, Pooran rocks back to cut it behind point for a single.
WIDE! Floated, but angling well down the leg side. Pooran misses the paddle and a wide is called.
Length, turning it into middle and leg, this is just wristed away through mid-wicket for one.
On the shorter side and around off, Brooks slaps it in front of square on the off side and races back for the second. Good running.
Just short of a length and on the body, Brooks flicks it off his hips towards square leg and picks up a single.
FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Back of a length again and outside off. Shamarh Brooks hops onto the back foot and slashes it past the diving point fielder to find the fence.
Back of a length, around off and this is cut away square of the wicket for a single.
A sharp bumper now from Ferguson, over middle and leg and Pooran just gets low to let it travel over his head.
Around the top of off, Nicholas Pooran gets behind the line of the ball to make the block.
On a good length and around off, Pooran plays it on the up and towards cover. No single taken.
Tossed up, around off and firmly driven but straight to mid off.
Flatter delivery, around off and this is tapped away towards cover-point.
Oh, that one kept low! This is quicker and fuller, outside off. Shamarh Brooks looks to cut off the back foot but the ball sneaks under his willow.
Flatter delivery, angled into middle and leg, Brooks plays it off the back foot and towards mid on.
Around middle and off, Pooran comes down the track and eases it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Edgy boundary! This is quicker and fuller, outside off. Nicholas Pooran throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge that runs away into the third man fence.

Drinks! Although the Windies have lost three wickets it is still their game to lose from here. The Kiwis started off perfectly getting an early breakthrough but they let the Windies batters build some partnerships after that. They did manage two more scalps but they need more than that. For the Windies, this stand between Nicholas Pooran and Shamarh Brooks is important and they will look to get as close as possible to the target. An exciting phase of play awaits us...
Good length, around off, Pooran guides it down to third man and collects a run.
A length ball, angled across the off pole and Pooran lets it through to the keeper.

Peach! Above 140 clicks yet again and served on a fuller length this time. This is very close to the off pole with the angle taking it away. Nicholas Pooran tries to block but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Well bowled! Lockie Ferguson bowls the heavy ball, at 144 clicks and angling across the left-hander. Nicholas Pooran plays inside the line of the ball.
Pitches it up now on off stump, Pooran solidly blocks it out.
Pace on, at 144 clicks and bowled around the hips. Brooks flicks it through square leg and picks up a single.
Fired in on middle and leg, Nicholas Pooran defends it from inside his crease.
This is angled into middle, Pooran blocks it out.
Just the single! Around off, this is stylishly driven by Shamarh Brooks and through covers for a run.
Full again, bowled at the toes, Nicholas Pooran works it in front of mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
This is pushed through quicker and fuller on off stump, Nicholas Pooran strokes it away onto the off side.
Starts from around the wicket to the left-hander and darts one into middle stump. Pooran gets rushed but managed to get some bat on it.
Change of ends for Michael Bracewell.
Good length, angling it into off stump. Brooks goes on the back foot and defends it out.
Goes full and outside off, Nicholas Pooran mistimes the cover drive towards wide mid off and scampers through for a quick run.
Good length, angling into the body. Brooks tucks it away towards mid-wicket and picks up a single.
SIX! Nonchalantly done! This is around the hips, Shamarh Brooks picks it up and just clips it aerially, over the backward square leg fence for a maximum.
Pacy delivery, short of a length and outside off. Brooks hops and taps it towards cover-point.
Good length, over middle and this is blocked out by Brooks.
Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies comes out to bat now. The Windies are in slight trouble here, can he be the man to guide them towards victory?

OUT! LBW! A very good review from New Zealand and they have got the breakthrough. Mitchell Santner bowls this one a bit flatter and slides it onto midle and leg. Keacy Carty looks to defend off the front foot but misses and gets hit on the pads. A huge appeal for lbw but it is turned down! After a bit of discussion, Kane Williamson decides to review it. UltraEdge shows there's no bat involved and Ball Tracking shows that the ball did straighten and would have hit the leg stump. The on-field decision is reversed and Santner gets his first wicket of the game.
This is full as well outside off, Keacy Carty strokes this straight to the cover fielder.
Mitchell Santner floats this one full outside off, Keacy Carty is watchful and leaves this alone.
Mitchell Santner flights this one as well on middle, Shamarh Brooks woeks this to the wide of mid on for a single.
Mitchell Santner tosses this one full outside off, Shamarh Brooks defends this to the off side.

There is an appeal! Mitchell Santner fires in a full delivery angling down leg. Shamarh Brooks looks to play at it but gets hit on the pads. The umpire says it is not out and the ball seems to clearly missing the leg stump.
Michael Bracewell floats this one full and outside off, Keacy Carty waits for the ball and plays it late towards third man. They get a couple of runs.
A fraction short and angling into the stumps, Keacy Carty pulls this straight to mid-wicket.
Michael Bracewell bowls this full and on middle, Keacy Carty clips this towards square leg.

Fires this one in outside off on a fuller length. Keacy Carty pushes at it and gets beaten. The bowler is interested and appeals for a caught-behind but the umpire remains unmoved. The sound is of the bat hitting the pad.
Michael Bracewell flights this one full and well outside off, Keacy Carty strokes this to deep cover and takes a couple of runs.
Quicker delivery bowled full and angling into the stumps, Shamarh Brooks knocks this to long on for a run.
Spin from both ends as Michael Bracewell comes on to bowl.
Bowls a loopy delivery full and outside off, Keacy Carty is happy to leave this one alone.
Mitchell Santner goes short once again and outside off, Keacy Carty cuts this straight to point.
Flights this one full and angling into the stumps, Keacy Carty defends the and ball takes an inside edge towards square leg.
Mitchell Santner flights this one full outside off, Keacy Carty works this to point and a misfield allows a single.
Quicker and shorter around off, Brooks plays it off the back foot towards point.
Full and on off, Keacy Carty drives it down to long off for a single.
On a good length and outside off, Keacy Carty guides this towards deep backward point for a single.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Keacy Carty works this towards point.
FOUR! What an over for West Indies! This will release all the pressure! Lockie Ferguson goes full on the pads, Keacy Carty helps it on his way and the ball runs away to fine leg for four more runs.
Lockie Ferguson strays onto the pads from a good length. Shamarh Brooks clips this down to fine leg for a single.
This is on a good length and just outside off, Shamarh Brooks knocks this towards mid on.

FOUR! Edged for a boundary this time! Lockie Ferguson bowls this back of a length and in line with the stumps, Shamarh Brooks gets on his toes and looks to fend. The ball takes an inside edge and goes to the keeper's left for a boundary to fine leg.

FIVE WIDES! This has taken off after pitching! Lockie Ferguson bowls this a fraction short and straying down leg. The ball kept rising after passing the batter and Tom Latham could not collect this to his left. Runs away to the fine leg boundary. The umpire says this is wide.
Powerplay 2! The fielding team can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the circle till the 40th over.
Tossed up, full and on off, Keacy Carty hits it to covers. Only 1 run from the over then.
Floated, full and on middle, Shamarh Brooks clips it towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Shamarh Brooks pushes it back to the bowler.
TURN AND BOUNCE! This is slower through the air, on off, turning away sharply with some bounces as well. Shamarh Brooks looks for the drive but gets beaten.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Shamarh Brooks knocks it towards short mid on.
Mitchell Santner starts with a floater, short and on middle, Shamarh Brooks blocks it to the leg side.
Mitchell Santner is on now.
Fuller one and on off again, Shamarh Brooks this time connects his drive towards mid off and scampers across for a single.
BEATEN! Lockie Ferguson serves this almost on yorker length and on off, Shamarh Brooks looks for the drive but misses it completely.
This is short again and outside off, Shamarh Brooks punches it on the bounce to mid off.
Lockie Ferguson bowls this short of a length and on middle, Shamarh Brooks hops up and bunts it onto the ground.
This is on a hard length and on off, Shamarh Brooks stays back and knocks it to covers.
Lockie Ferguson starts with a good length delivery and on middle, Shamarh Brooks tucks it away nicely towards deep square leg for a brace.
Here comes the first bowling change as Lockie Ferguson has been handed the ball.
Fuller one and on middle, Shamarh Brooks looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge towards covers.
Good bowling by Southee. This is on a good length and on the fifth stump line, holds its line, Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone.
Tim Southee continues to bowl full here, this one is on off, Keacy Carty drives it firmly wide of mid off for a single and gets off the mark.
Similiar delivery, full and on off, shaping away, Keacy Carty again has no intention to play at it.
Full again but this time around off, shaping away, Keacy Carty lifts his bat and lets it go to the keeper.
A bit of movement there. This is full and on middle, moves away a bit in the air, Keacy Carty does well to block it out.
Length dleivery and outside off, Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone.
FOUR! Another one. Boult goes short this time and outside off, Shamarh Brooks stays there and cuts it just over the jumping point fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Brooks gets going now. Trent Boult serves this full and around off, Shamarh Brooks takes his front foot towards the ball and drives it sweetly through covers for a boundary.
Another length delivery and outside off, angling away too, Shamarh Brooks offers no shot at it.
Fuller one and outside off, angling away, Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone.
On a length and on off, Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards covers.

Keacy Carty is the new man in. There is a slight delay as there is an issue with the bowler's run-up area. A groundstaff comes out with sawdust and does the repaiwork. All seems fine now and we are good to continue.

OUT! TAKEN! Shai Hope looks to be aggressive but gets dismissed here. Tim Southee bowls this a bit fuller and on off, Shai Hope goes for the lofted drive over mid off but hits it off the toe end of his bat and in the air. Kane Williamson, there settles under it and completes a nice catch. This was not a usual Hope innings that we are familiar with and he has to go back now.
Commentary.Howout: c Kane Williamson b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! This is again on a good length and outside off, Shai Hope has a wild swing at it but cannot connect.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Shai Hope knocks it towards covers.
FOUR! Good timing! This is full and on middle, Shai Hope moves across a bit and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length again and on off, Shamarh Brooks thinks about playing it but decides against it at the last moment and gets an inside edge just past the leg stump.
This one did not bounce at all. Tim Southee bowls this on a length and on off, Shamarh Brooks looks to play at it but it goes under his bat and on two bounces to the keeper.

FOUR! Shai Hope is looking really good here! Trent Boult bowls this a fraction full and gives width outside off. Shai Hope caresses the ball past point and the ball rushes towards the deep point fence for four runs.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside the off stump. This is worked towards point.
Goes full and on off, Shai Hope just punches this to the bowler's left and the ball beats mid off. They take a couple of runs as the ball has not been hit too hard.
Trent Boult bowls this on a good length and outside off, Shai Hope finds the cover-point fielder this time.
WIDE! This is well down leg side and Tom Latham does well to collect this. The umpire calls this wide.
Trent Boult serves this on a good length and outside off, Shai Hope knocks this towards point.
Trent Boult bowls a full delivery swinging into the stumps, Shai Hope clips the ball to mid-wicket.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside the off pole, Shai Hope guides this to third man for a single and will keep strike.
This is on a good length and outside off, Shai Hope knocks this towards mid off.
Tim Southee goes fuller this time outside off, Shai Hope strokes the ball straight to cover.
Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Shai Hope fends this back down the pitch.

WIDE! Tim Southee bowls this on a length and going down leg. The umpire indicates it is wide but the bowler is convinced there is bat involved. Nothing from the keeper and Kane Williamson doesn't review. Replays show it clipped the legs.
SIX! BANG! This has been dismissed away! Tim Southee goes short once again and bowls this outside off, Shai Hope pulls this towards deep square leg for a biggie. That was a hell of a shot!
Tim Southee bowls a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Shai Hope slaps this straight to point.
Trent Boult serves this on a good length and outside off, Shamarh Brooks defends this back to the bowler.
Shamarh Brooks comes in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT-BEHIND! Trent Boult finally gets what he was looking for here. He bowls this on a good length again and on off, nips away sharply after hitting the deck, Kyle Mayers looks to push it away from his crease without much footwork. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards the left of the keeper and Tom Latham dives that side to do the rest. This is just what the Kiwis needed. Can they build on this?
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Trent Boult

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nice shot! This is short of a length and outside off, Kyle Mayers stays there and crunches it through cover-point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Trent Boult again bowls this on a good length and on the fifth stump line, holds its line, Kyle Mayers looks to push it to the off side but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes a bit fuller and on leg, angling in, Kyle Mayers knocks it back towards the bowler.
Beautiful delivery! This is on a good length and around off, shaping away, Kyle Mayers lifts his bat and lets it go the keeper.
Tim Southee bowls this in line with the stumps and on a fuller length, Shai Hope clips the ball to mid-wicket.
Tim Southee strays onto the pads this time and serves this full, Kyle Mayers clips this towards fine leg. A good stop at the boundary restricts them to s single.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off, Mayers leaves this one alone.
Serves this one well outside off on a fuller length, Kyle Mayers goes for the drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tim Southee goes full this time and outside off, Shai Hope knocks the ball to cover and a misfield allows them to take a single.
Tim Southee begins with a short ball angling into leg, Kyle Mayers pulls this to fine leg for a single.
Tim Southee to take the other new ball.

FOUR! Big over for West Indies with the delay! Trent Boult bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Shai Hope cuts this well over the point fielder for a boundary to deep point. 10 runs have come from the first over.
Trent Boult begins after the break with a full delivery really wide outside off, Shai Hope sways his arms and tries to reach for it but gets beaten.
Right then! The umpires and players are back out in the middle. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers are set to resume their stay at the crease. It will be Trent Boult to finish off his incomplete first over.

UPDATE 3.54 am IST (10.24 pm GMT, the previous day) - The rain has eased off and the covers are off too. Just the groundstaff working to get the outfield dry and we will have a resumption real soon. There is an official word and play will resume at 4 am IST (10.30 pm GMT, the previous day).

UPDATE 3.44 am IST (10.14 pm GMT, the previous day) - The players are rushing off the field as the rain has gotten heavy. The groundstaff is running out with the covers to put on the center patch. The umpires though are out in the middle and it is clearing up a bit on the eastern end. This might be another delay. Stick around for more updates. As expected, it has gotten better and the covers seem to be taken off.
FOUR! Shai Hope gets off the mark and in some style too. This is pitched up, well outside off. Hope leans in and strokes it away with excellent timing and through covers for a boundary.
A touch fuller and in that channel around off, shaping back in. Hope makes a good leave.
WIDE! This is down the leg side and swinging further down. Hope misses the flick and a wide is called.
Nicely bowled! On a nagging length and around off, bringing the ball back into the right-hander. Shai Hope stays watchful as he defends this one out.
Length again, outside off and angling away, Shai Hope lets it through to the keeper.
WIDE! Trent Boult looks for some swing and gets it but it is a bit too wide. This is on a length and well outside off, shaping further away. Wided!
